scripts.dev:server: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/run-with-env.mjs go -C server run github.com/air-verse/air@v1.67.4 -c .air.toml
scripts.migrate:server: node --env-file-if-exists=.env.local scripts/run-with-env.mjs go -C server run ./cmd/migrate -dir migrations
scripts.acceptance:finance: pnpm run acceptance:finance-bill-batch -- --apply && pnpm run acceptance:finance-ui
scripts.check:web: pnpm --dir web lint && pnpm --dir web test
scripts.check:server: go -C server test ./... && go -C server vet ./...
scripts.check: pnpm run check:web && pnpm run check:server
scripts.build: pnpm run build:web && pnpm run build:server
